quote: During the three and six months ended June 30, 2025, 2.5 million and 5.9 million Tranche 2 Warrants were exercised, respectively, which resulted in immaterial cash receipts.
issuer_treatment: H1 2025 : warrants de réorganisation, pas warrants clients ; exercices tranche 1 génèrent seulement 0,6 M sur semestre, tranche 2 encaissements insignifiants. Les millions de titres exerçables ne valent pas une capacité de financement cash correspondante.
